description: Every day at 17:00, compares each configured practice's open Cliniko invoices against recent Xero payments. Cliniko's invoice API is read-only, so an invoice paid in Xero but still shown Open in Cliniko can't be closed automatically - this lists each one as an exception to close by hand, alert-only.
